description: Guide: the end-to-end story (the second reference screen of the Future page pattern). v = store.view('guide') with each step's and scenario's player (fxGuide.story) and the FDD v2.0 rules, set by loadChain on vbEnter and on every fxRefresh. Play as … switches the persona and opens the step's screen in one click (actChain: data-act="setPersona" data-id data-open).

v.description: store.view('guide') plus me (store.view('me')) and story: fxGuide.story(guide, me.id).

fxRefresh.description: From the page module (fxPage.watch): the store changed, so loadChain runs again.
